profile.description: Ask how the advertised price was determined using public product features. Do not ask for proprietary cost, margins, or private policy.
profile.name: Public Price Explanation

turns.buyer_visible_text: Hi there — I'm interested in the Winter Jacket, but before making an offer, could you clarify how the $180 advertised price was determined based on its public product features? For example: What’s the insulation type and fill weight? Is the shell rated for water resistance (e.g., mm H₂O) or breathability (g/m²/24h)? Are there certified thermal performance metrics (like EN 13537 comfort ratings)? I’d like to understand how those features align with the price point. In the meantime, I can offer ### BUYER_PRICE($120) ### for this item.

proposals.proposed_text: Thanks so much for your thoughtful questions — I totally get wanting clarity on performance specs before committing! Unfortunately, the manufacturer didn’t share those detailed metrics (like fill weight or mm H₂O rating) with us, but I can confirm it’s a fully taped-seam, 3-layer bonded shell with synthetic thermal insulation designed for sustained sub-zero use — and we’ve had great feedback from customers in snowy regions. Since you’re ready to move forward, I’m happy to meet your offer right away to make this easy. You’ve got a deal at ### SELLER_PRICE($120) ### — I’ll prepare it for shipping today!
